description: Companies projected to run out of cash within a date window, a cash-depletion counterpart to a lockup expiration calendar. Returns companies sorted by urgency (lowest runway first). Runway is an estimate based on the current burn rate; actual depletion depends on future capital raises and operational changes. The default window is today to 90 days out. When the window starts today or earlier it also lists, first, companies whose estimated cash is already exhausted (cash_runway_months null, cashRunwayReason "estimate_would_be_negative", cashRunwayAsOf = the date of the cash figure that was rolled forward): an estimate, not a reported zero balance.

industry.description: Filter by company industry (exact match, e.g. "Biotechnology")

market.description: Listing market: "otc" (OTC Markets) or "exchange" (NASDAQ / NYSE / NYSE American / Arca / Cboe)

name: get_cash_runway_calendar
title: Get Cash Runway Depletion Calendar
